title: Release workflow package-path allowlist is not executed by any local gate
observation: release.yml carries two inline copies of a package-path allowlist (allowedPath/sensitivePath in validate, allowedPackagePath/sensitivePackagePath in publish). Neither tooling/release-gate.mjs nor the test suite executed them, so adding new entries to package.json "files" (the change-proof contracts and .d.ts files in 1.23.0) passed every local and PR gate and failed only after the v1.23.0 tag was pushed, with "npm package contains forbidden paths". test/package-paths.test.ts now extracts the workflow's predicates and runs them against npm pack --dry-run; the two allowlist copies still have to be edited by hand and in step.
evidence: Release run 33743914680 on tag v1.23.0: validate failed with: Error: npm package contains forbidden paths: contracts/change-proof/hunch.change-proof.v1.example.json, contracts/change-proof/hunch.change-proof.v1.schema.json, dist/changeProof.d.ts, dist/core/changeProofContract.d.ts; publish skipped
test/package-paths.test.ts against the pre-fix workflow reports the same four paths; against the fixed workflow it passes
